text: Done in 127007e and bbe39bd (17 November 2026). A mixed MRI, EEG, PET and MEG study is accepted with a level for every file; EEG, iEEG, MEG, NIRS, PET, perfusion and motion are described and queryable; uninterpreted content is preserved and labelled; a root archive_description.json makes an archive. Verified by CoverageLevelsSuite and CoveragePersistenceSuite (both catalogs and HTTP), the full unit and PostgreSQL gate, and the historical-upgrade check. Limits: directory recordings are preserved, not described; file moves are not offered for described data types.
